identifier_rules.master_register: territorial master id such as GC-FIS-###, TF-FIS-###, LZ-FIS-### or NAT-FIS-###
identifier_rules.external_registration: REGAGE/RedSARA/AGE receipt or other official external identifier
identifier_rules.caret_rule: Caret is identity-only. Communication events remain immutable event IDs and do not receive synthetic caret identities.

proof_boundaries.es: Registro no equivale a entrega interna, reparto, incorporación, examen, admisión, investigación o fondo. Una respuesta localizada recibe un evento canónico propio; una respuesta no localizada permanece como brecha y no se sintetiza.
proof_boundaries.en: Registration is not internal delivery, allocation, incorporation, examination, admission, investigation or merits. A located response receives its own canonical event; an unlocated response remains a gap and is not synthesised.
